sentences.text: Solicitor Priya Shah attended the meeting with client Leanne Carter.
The purpose of the meeting was for the solicitor to take instructions on protection from ex-partner Ryan Hale after a history of abuse.
Client Leanne Carter stated that her ex-partner is Ryan Hale.
Ryan Hale and Leanne Carter were together for about six years.
The couple split in August, and Ryan moved out to his brother's house.
Leanne Carter is still living at 9 Calder Court, which is her tenancy in her name.
Client has a daughter named Mia, who is four years old.
Mia is at nursery this morning.
Ryan Hale is Mia's biological father.
Ryan Hale was seeing Mia on Sundays before October, and Leanne stopped this after October.
Ryan Hale comes to the flat every weekend since August, typically on Friday or Saturday night, by shouting through the letterbox.
Ryan Hale has not been physically violent towards Leanne Carter since August, except for one incident on the 12th of October.
On the 12th of October, Ryan Hale put his hands around Leanne's neck in the hallway while she was opening the door to give Mia's bag.
Leanne was unable to breathe for a period after the incident.
Mia was asleep in her room during the incident on the 12th of October.
Leanne's neighbour called the police after hearing her screaming during the incident on the 12th of October.
Leanne has a crime reference number for the incident on the 12th of October.
Ryan Hale was arrested by the police on the 12th of October.
Ryan Hale was released on bail after the arrest, but the bail was later discharged and he is now under investigation with no bail conditions.
Leanne went to her GP two days after the 12th of October, and the GP recorded marks on her neck.
On the 20th of October, Ryan Hale came to the flat and smashed Leanne's phone, which she had to replace at a cost of about two hundred pounds.
Leanne reported the phone-smashing incident to the officer on the case.
On the 3rd of November, Ryan Hale sent a text message to Leanne threatening to kill her.
Leanne has a screenshot of the threatening text message from the 3rd of November.
Leanne has additional voice notes from Ryan Hale threatening her, saying 'I'll regret it'.
Leanne's friend Gemma told her that Ryan Hale keeps a knife in his van for work.
Leanne has not personally seen the knife in Ryan Hale's van.
Leanne wants Ryan Hale to stop coming to the flat and stop messaging her.
The solicitor advised that a non-molestation order should be applied for to prevent Ryan Hale from contacting Leanne, using or threatening violence, and coming within a set radius,
The non-molestation order could be made without notice to Ryan Hale due to the history of strangulation and threats to kill.
